$comment: Provenance: read from identity at 608fa9afa5cb1704c3c85bde2e1c81aab9f1dbf2, from the event builder in internal/outbox. The commit is fleet.yml's sourceCommit for identity.
title: identity.user.created payload
description: The `data` payload of the `identity.user.created` event: a signup completed, before email verification. TWO fields, and the emptiness is the contract rather than an unfinished schema — the publisher's builder marshals a struct of exactly these two, at the commit named in the `$comment`. Three properties that used to be here — an `email_verified` boolean, a `locale` and an `account_ids` array — are DELETED rather than left optional, because optional is the same lie in a softer form: a schema that names a field no publisher sends is a contract that lies, and it lies green. What a consumer wants from each of the three is already on the bus elsewhere, and that is where to get it: `identity.user.email_verified` is what makes the address trustworthy, and the tenancy events are what say who is in which account. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

user_id.description: The new user. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`, so a consumer can key on either. A bare uuid rather than a `usr_`-prefixed id: that is what identity's `id.UUID.String()` produces, and it is the same value courier and billing already key users on (D7).

email.description: Email address as typed at signup, lowercased and trimmed. Unverified: the verification event is what makes it trustworthy.
